Starts or stops the counter. If True, the counting is started, otherwise it is stopped.

Defines the counter's behavior. Possible values for this property are 0 - Preset: The counting is stopped when the value set in the Preset property is reached (default) or 1 - Infinite: The counting goes on indefinitely
Indicates that the counting must restart from zero after it reaches the value established in the Preset property. This property is only valid when the CounterType property is set to 0 - Preset.
Limit to be reached by the counter, in seconds. In case the value of this property is not a multiple of the value of the Increment property, the Tag reaches this value before the next increment.
Enables restarting the counting (from zero) each time the value of the Enabled property returns to True. When disabled, the counter restarts counting from the point it was previously interrupted.

Defines the update interval of the Value property. In case the value of this property is modified while the counting is on, this modification is only effective when the counter is stopped and restarted.

Displays the counting of the counter, in seconds. This is a read-only property.
